answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to maintain a persistent behavioral anchor over successive epochs. New identities start with limited privileges and must demonstrate consistent, high-quality contributions that survive peer review. Only after the tide of repeated, attested work rises does the identity unlock full voting or grading power. A sudden saffron-colored burst of activity from a fresh cluster looks anomalous against that history and can be rate-limited or quarantined until the pattern stabilizes, raising the cost of farming many coordinated fakes.
